title: ARMS extends into the roster
body: ARMS extends the roster. Its server runs against a real database, serves its health endpoint on its protocol port and listens for the game in WebSocket mode, with the NEX surface registered. Console testing is the unthrown punch: nothing here has faced the retail game yet. When it does, extendable-arm bouts will be among the first matches on the schedule — grab the beta programme if you want to be the arm that throws it.
